label: D2 in S2 after an unrewarded trial, when the agent is not firmly committed to a2
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when state S2 is shown (100% of activations; never S1, D1 or GO). Inside that, about 94% of mass comes from trials whose previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward == 0). Adding the agents own policy logit at D2 (choice > -2, i.e. not strongly preferring a2) brings dev F1 from 0.53 to 0.72 (mass recall 0.93). The biggest activations are rare transitions: a1 chosen, S2 reached, after a loss (top-quartile coverage 71% vs 18% in the bottom quartile). Common a2 to S2 after a loss gives weaker activations. A version using only history, (D2 & S2 & prev_reward==0 & (action==1 | reward two trials back==0)), scores F1 0.68. It is weak or silent after rewarded trials and when the agent is confidently committed to a2. All variables are observed or computed by the model, so nothing future is used.
